# buildinfo

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/pkg/v1/proc/buildinfo"
```

Package buildinfo is what the running binary was built from: the toolchain, the main package, the main module with its version-control stamp, and every dependency followed through its replacement.

```
build, ok := buildinfo.Build()
sdk, found := build.Module("github.com/kitsunium/sdk")
// sdk.Version is a release ("v0.4.6"), or "" with sdk.Revision/sdk.Time
// for a pseudo-version, or "" with sdk.Local for a directory.
```

A module's recorded version conflates three things, and [Module](#Module) keeps them apart: a RELEASE in Version, a COMMIT in Revision and Time (a pseudo-version names one, and so does the main module's version-control stamp), and a DIRECTORY in Local and Dir (a replace, a workspace module). Nothing here fails: a binary built without module support reads as false.

The same values are re-exported by pkg/v1/proc/process, beside the spawning of children and the process's runtime statistics. This package is the reading alone, so that a program asking only what it was built from imports neither the spawn engine nor runtime/metrics, whose initialisation every process importing them pays at start (ADR 0172).

<a name="BuildInfo"></a>
## type [BuildInfo](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/pkg/v1/proc/buildinfo/gen_facade.go>)

BuildInfo is what the running binary was built from: the toolchain, the main package, the main module with its version-control stamp, and every dependency followed through its replacement. It is an alias of the service value, and the same type as pkg/v1/proc/process.BuildInfo.

```go
type BuildInfo = svcbuild.BuildValue
```

BuildInfo is an alias of `github.com/kitsunium/sdk/internal/service/proc/buildinfo.BuildValue`, declared as:

```go
type BuildInfo struct {
	// GoVersion is the toolchain that built the binary, e.g. "go1.27.1".
	GoVersion string
	// Path is the import path of the main package, e.g.
	// "github.com/acme/app/cmd/server".
	Path      string
	// Main is the main module.
	Main      ModuleValue
	// Deps are the dependencies linked into the binary, in the order the
	// toolchain recorded them.
	Deps      []ModuleValue
	// Toolchain is how the toolchain built the binary: the target, the
	// compiler, the flags and the cgo setting, read from the build settings.
	Toolchain ToolchainValue
	// Settings are every build setting the toolchain recorded, verbatim and in
	// its order — the vcs stamp and the toolchain's included, and a key a later
	// toolchain adds that Toolchain does not name.
	Settings  []SettingValue
}
```

<a name="BuildInfo.Reproducible"></a>
### func \(BuildInfo\) [Reproducible](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/proc/buildinfo/build.go>)

```go
func (*BuildInfo) Reproducible() bool
```

Reproducible reports whether the build can be made again byte for byte from its source: built with -trimpath, from a recorded revision, with no uncommitted change. It is false for a build that does not say — one outside version control, or a Bazel build, which stamps none of the three.

<a name="Module"></a>
## type [Module](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/pkg/v1/proc/buildinfo/gen_facade.go>)

Module is one module of the running binary, with its release, its commit and its local directory told apart. It is an alias of the service value, and the same type as pkg/v1/proc/process.Module.

```go
type Module = svcbuild.ModuleValue
```

Module is an alias of `github.com/kitsunium/sdk/internal/service/proc/buildinfo.ModuleValue`, declared as:

```go
type Module struct {
	// Time is the commit's time, when known: the main module's vcs.time
	// stamp, or the timestamp a pseudo-version carries. Zero otherwise.
	Time        time.Time
	// Path is the module path the build required, e.g.
	// "github.com/kitsunium/sdk".
	Path        string
	// Version is the released version the code came from, e.g. "v0.4.6", or
	// "" when there is none to tell: a pseudo-version (a commit, in Revision),
	// a module built from a local directory, or a main module built without
	// one. A "+dirty" suffix is not kept here; it is what Modified says.
	Version     string
	// Revision is the version-control commit the code came from, when known:
	// the main module's vcs.revision stamp (a full object name), or the
	// commit a pseudo-version names (its twelve-character prefix).
	Revision    string
	// Dir is the directory a replace directive pointed the module at, as the
	// toolchain recorded it — relative to the main module, or to the
	// workspace root in workspace mode — or "" when it was not replaced by a
	// directory. A workspace module is Local with no Dir: the toolchain does
	// not record where it was.
	Dir         string
	// Replacement is the module path a replace directive substituted, when it
	// substituted another module rather than a directory; Version is then
	// that module's.
	Replacement string
	// Local reports that the code came from a directory on the build machine
	// rather than from a published version: a directory replacement, a
	// workspace module, or a main module built inside its own source tree.
	Local       bool
	// Modified reports that the build included uncommitted changes: the main
	// module's vcs.modified stamp, or the "+dirty" its version carried. The
	// toolchain records nothing of the kind for a dependency.
	Modified    bool
}
```

## type [Toolchain](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/pkg/v1/proc/buildinfo/gen_facade.go>)

Toolchain is how the toolchain built the binary: its target, compiler, flags and cgo setting. It is an alias of the service value, and the same type as pkg/v1/proc/process.Toolchain.

```go
type Toolchain = svcbuild.ToolchainValue
```

Toolchain is an alias of `github.com/kitsunium/sdk/internal/service/proc/buildinfo.ToolchainValue`, declared as:

```go
type Toolchain struct {
	// OS is the target operating system, GOOS, e.g. "linux".
	OS             string
	// Arch is the target architecture, GOARCH, e.g. "amd64".
	Arch           string
	// ArchLevel is the architecture's feature level — GOAMD64, GOARM, GO386,
	// GOARM64 and their siblings — e.g. "v3", which needs AVX2 on the host.
	ArchLevel      string
	// Compiler is the compiler toolchain, -compiler, e.g. "gc".
	Compiler       string
	// BuildMode is the -buildmode flag, e.g. "exe" or "pie".
	BuildMode      string
	// Tags are the build tags, -tags, in the order given; none when the build
	// named none.
	Tags           []string
	// LDFlags is the -ldflags flag as given, e.g. "-s -w -X main.v=1".
	LDFlags        string
	// DefaultGODEBUG is the GODEBUG default the binary runs with before its
	// environment's, e.g. "httpmuxgo121=1".
	DefaultGODEBUG string
	// CgoEnabled reports that CGO_ENABLED was 1.
	CgoEnabled     bool
	// Trimpath reports that -trimpath was set: file paths in panics and
	// profiles are module paths, not the build machine's directories.
	Trimpath       bool
}
```
